description.p: TypeDH is a focused desktop touch-typing tutor for the Colemak-DH layout. Everything stays on your computer.

ul.li: A staged course that introduces a few keys at a time with real-word drills
Smart practice that targets the keys you miss most or type slowest
Timed speed tests and practice with your own text
Live keyboard and finger guidance, including Shift
Statistics with speed trends, a per-key heatmap, and an activity calendar
